header: Configure Microsoft Defender XDR to stream Advanced Hunting events to your Azure Event Hub
content:
stream Advanced Hunting events to
your Azure Event Hub
Article • 09/24/2024
Applies to:
Microsoft Defender XDR
Prior to configuring Microsoft Defender XDR to stream data to Event Hubs, ensure the
following prerequisites are fulfilled:
1. Create an Event Hubs (for information, see Set up Event Hubs).
2. Creating an Event Hubs Namespace (for information, see Set up Event Hubs
namespace).
3. Add permissions to the entity who has the privileges of a Contributor so that this
entity can export data to the Event Hubs. For more information on adding
permissions, see Add permissions
